correctness.rationale: The Dini integral is equivalent, up to dyadic comparison constants, to summability of the roof modulus along the exponentially contracting stable/unstable scales. Substituting this tail into Wen's Lemmas 3.1 and 3.2 gives convergent coordinate corrections, uniform local closeness, and a vanishing product-time displacement; Wen's uniqueness argument then applies. Positivity on the compact base supplies the needed lower roof bound. No finite experiment is used.
